def _json_safe_value(value: object) -> object:
    """Return a JSON-safe value without leaking SDK objects through `data`."""
    if _is_json_scalar(value):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, BaseModel):
        return value.model_dump(mode="json")
    if _is_dataclass_instance(value):
        return _json_safe_value(asdict(value))
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return _PublicDataMapping(
            {str(key): _json_safe_value(item) for key, item in value.items()}
        )
    if _is_json_sequence(value):
        return [_json_safe_value(item) for item in cast("Sequence[object]", value)]
    return {"type": type(value).__name__, "preview": preview_value(value)}

from __future__ import annotations

from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

import llm_router

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


def _build(raw: str, override: str) -> object:
    output = llm_router._internal.runtime.output
    result = SimpleNamespace(
        data={},
        provider=SimpleNamespace(value="google"),
        model=llm_router.Model.GEMINI_FLASH_LITE,
        output_text=raw,
        usage=None,
        tool_calls=(),
    )
    return output.build_public_response(result, output_text=override)


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_RESPONSE_NORMALIZATION[revision==1]")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("override", ["normalized text", ""], ids=["text", "empty"])
def test_output_text_override_wins_over_raw_provider_text(override: str) -> None:
    response = _build("raw provider text", override)
    assert response.output_text == override
    assert response.provider == "google"
